import sys
from docx import Document
from docx.oxml.ns import qn

path = sys.argv[1]
doc = Document(path)

print("=== BODY ELEMENT ORDER ===")
body = doc.element.body
for i, child in enumerate(body.iterchildren()):
    tag = child.tag.split('}')[-1]
    if tag == 'p':
        text = ''.join(n.text or '' for n in child.iter(qn('w:t')))
        hl = child.findall('.//' + qn('w:hyperlink'))
        numpr = child.findall('.//' + qn('w:numPr'))
        ppr = child.find(qn('w:pPr'))
        style = None
        if ppr is not None:
            ps = ppr.find(qn('w:pStyle'))
            if ps is not None:
                style = ps.get(qn('w:val'))
        print("%02d P style=%s hl=%d numPr=%d text=%r" % (i, style, len(hl), len(numpr), text[:70]))
    elif tag == 'tbl':
        grid = child.findall('.//' + qn('w:gridCol'))
        rows = child.findall('.//' + qn('w:tr'))
        print("%02d TABLE grid=%d rows=%d" % (i, len(grid), len(rows)))
    else:
        print("%02d %s" % (i, tag))

print("\n=== TABLE DETAIL ===")
for t in doc.tables:
    print("style:", t.style.name if t.style else None, "align:", t.alignment)
    print("autofit:", t.autofit)
    print("tblPr:", t._tbl.tblPr.xml[:3000])
    print("grid cols:")
    for gc in t._tbl.tblGrid.iterchildren():
        print("  ", gc.get(qn('w:w')))
    for ri, row in enumerate(t.rows):
        cells = []
        for c in row.cells:
            cells.append("(%r w=%s)" % (c.text, c.width))
        print(ri, " | ".join(cells))

print("\n=== PARAGRAPH/RUN DUMP ===")
for i, p in enumerate(doc.paragraphs):
    if not p.text.strip():
        continue
    print("--- P%d style=%s align=%s" % (i, p.style.name, p.alignment))
    print("   text:", repr(p.text))
    for r in p.runs:
        col = None
        try:
            col = r.font.color.rgb
        except Exception:
            pass
        print("   run: %r bold=%s italic=%s underline=%s strike=%s sub=%s sup=%s color=%s" % (
            r.text, r.bold, r.italic, r.underline, r.font.strike, r.font.subscript, r.font.superscript, col))

print("\n=== DOCX PARTS ===")
import zipfile
z = zipfile.ZipFile(path)
for n in z.namelist():
    print(n)
print("\n=== RELS ===")
print(z.read('word/_rels/document.xml.rels').decode('utf-8'))
